sa: भवांस्तु भावतत्त्वज्ञो विद्वान् ज्ञानतपोऽन्वितः॥ कालं पश्यति सुव्यक्तं पाणावामलकं यथा।
en: You, however, know the truth of existence. You are learned and endued with wisdom and penance. You sec Time as clearly like an embolic myrobalan on the palm of your hand.

sa: अप्रमत्तः प्रमत्तेषु कालो जागर्ति देहिषु॥ प्रयत्नेनाप्यपक्रान्तो दृष्टपूर्वो न केनचित्।
en: All embodied beings may be careless of Time, but Time is careful and is wide awake behind them. No one has ever been seen to have driven off Time from him.

sa: विश्वामित्र उवाच मित्रं च मे ब्राह्मणस्यायमात्मा प्रियश्च मे पूज्यतमश्च तं धर्तुकामोऽहमिमां जिहीषे। नृशंसानामीदृशानां न बिभ्ये॥ लोके।
en: I am a Brahman. This my body is my friend. It is very dear to me and deserves the highest respect from me. In order to keep up the body I wish to take away that dog's haunch. I have become so eager that I do not fear you and your dreadful brother any longer.

sa: एतद् वै जन्मसामर्थ्य ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः। आत्मज्ञानं शमश्चैव पर्याप्तं तत्परायणम्॥
en: This knowledge is the possession of a Brahmana in particular by virtue of his birth. Knowledge of the Soul, and happiness like above, are each fully sufficient to lead to Liberation.

sa: केवलात्मा तथा चैव केवलेन समेत्य वै। स्वतन्त्रश्च स्वतन्त्रेण स्वतन्त्रत्वमवाप्नुते॥
en: By uniting with the One independent Soul, he becomes One and Independent. Uniting with One that is dependent on One's Own Self, he attains to the same nature and acquires Independence.

sa: अन्योन्यं समभिप्रेत्य मैथुनस्य समागमे। उपद्रव इवाविष्टो योनि गर्भः प्रपद्यते॥
en: In an act of sexual intercourse, when two persons of opposite sexes come into contact with one another, the embryo takes birth in the womb, like a calamity attacking the mother.

sa: एतानशिष्टान् बुध्यस्व नित्यं लोभसमन्वितान्। शिष्टांस्तु परिपृच्छेथा यान् वक्ष्यामि शुचिव्रतान्॥
en: They who are always under the influence of covetousness are wicked. I shall now tell you of those about whom you ask,—those who are called good and whose practices are pure.

sa: वयं हि भवता सर्वे गुणक्रीता विशेषतः। यस्त्वमात्महितं त्यक्त्वा मामेवेहानुरुध्यसे॥
en: All of us have certainly been purchased by you with your merits, since you disregarding what is for your own good, has employed your time in seeking the well-being of ourselves!

sa: प्रजापतेः सलोकतां बृहस्पतेः शतक्रतोः। व्रजन्ति ते परां गतिं गृहस्थधर्मसेतुभिः॥
en: By walking along the high road formed by the duties of domesticity, men acquire happy ends by acquiring the region of Prajapati or Brihaspati or of him of a hundred sacrifices.

sa: ततोऽग्निमुपसंगृह्य भगवाँल्लोकपूजितः। प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कल्पयामास वै प्रभुः॥
en: Suppressing that fire that had been destroying the universe, the illustrious Brahma, worshipped of all, and endued with illimitable power, then arranged for both birth and death of all living creatures.

sa: तस्यात्मानमथाविश्य योगसिद्धो महामुनिः। रुद्ध्वा धनपतिं देवं योगेन हतवान् वसु॥
en: The great ascetic Ushanas, crowned with Yoga-success, entered the person of Kuvera, and depriving the lord of wealth of his liberty by means of Yoga, robbed him of all his riches.

sa: विकर्मणा तप्यमानः पापाद् विपरिमुच्यते। नैतत् कार्यं पुनरिति द्वितीयात् परिमुच्यते॥
en: From a sinful act committed only once, one may clear himself by repenting for it. From an act committed twice, one may purify himself by vowing never to repeat the act.

sa: असत्प्रलाप पारुष्यं पैशुन्यमनृतं तथा। चत्वारि वाचा राजेन्द्र न जल्पेन्नानुचिन्तयेत्॥
en: The four acts which are done with words, O king, and which should never be done or even thought of, are evil conversation, harsh words, giving other people's faults, and falsehood.

sa: प्रसन्नैरिन्द्रियैर्यद् यत् संकल्पयति मानसम्। तत् तत् स्वप्नेऽप्युगते मनो हृष्यन्निरीक्षते॥
en: (When one is awake) whatever objects a person perceives in the mind through the senses in a clear state are apprehended by the mind in dreams while the senses are inactive.

sa: लीलायन्त्यः कुलं घ्नन्ति कूलानीव सरिद्वराः। दोषान् सर्वांश्च मत्वाऽऽशु प्रजापतिरभाषत॥
en: Seeking what they consider happiness, they destroy the family even as many rivers wash away the banks that contain them. The Creator himself had said this marking the faults of women.

sa: गृहस्थानां तु सर्वेषां विनाशमभिकासताम्। निधनं शोभनं तात पुलिनेषु क्रियावताम्॥
en: When they sacrifice their lives, it is laudable for all householders observing the duties of men living in sacred places to give up their lives on the banks of sacred rivers.

sa: न कश्चित् त्राति वै राजन् दिष्टान्तवशमागतम्। सावशेषायुषं चापि कश्चिन्नैवापकर्षति॥
en: One whose lease of life has run out, cannot be saved by any body. Likewise, one whose lease of life has not run out can never be killed by any one.

sa: पञ्चेन्द्रियेषु भूतेषु सर्वं वसति दैवतम्। आदित्यश्चन्द्रमा वायुर्ब्रह्मा प्राणः क्रतुर्यमः॥
en: All the gods live in every creature who have the five senses. The Sun, the Moon, the God of Wind, Brahman, Vital Airs, Kratu and Yama, (these live in living creatures).

sa: ततः सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणो राजसत्तम। सम्मतश्चाभवत् तेषामाश्रमे तन्निवासिनाम्॥
en: As the result of all this, O foremost of kings, that Brahmana gained the highest success. He became an object of respect with all the ascetics who lived in that asylum.

sa: प्राणिनां सर्वतो वायुश्चेष्टां वर्तयते पृथक्। प्राणनाच्चैव भूतानां प्राण इत्यभिधीयते॥
en: The wind is the root of the various functions of all living creatures, and because living creatures are enabled to live by it, therefore is the wind called Prana (or life).

sa: शुक्रतो रसतश्चैव देहाज्जायन्ति जन्तवः। स्वभावात् कर्मयोगाद् वा तानुपेक्षेत बुद्धिमान्॥
en: From the seminal fluid and sweat creatures spring from the body, influenced by pristino acts or in the course of nature. Therefore, a wise man should feel no regard for them.

sa: यदा च सुरकार्यं ते अविषां भविष्यति॥ प्रादुर्भावं गमिष्यामि तदाऽऽत्मज्ञानदैशिकः।
en: At such time, however, when it will be difficult for you to accomplish the work of the gods, I shall then appear in incarnate forms perceiving the gravity of the emergencies.

sa: ये चापि तेषां श्रोतारः सदा सदसि सम्मताः। विज्ञानगुणसम्पन्नास्तेभ्यश्च स्पृहयाम्यहम्॥
en: Indeed, my heart longs after them who endued with knowledge and all desirable attributes, and honoured by others, listen to such words when uttered in assemblies or the courts of kings.

sa: मे त्वत्तः प्रियतरो लोकेऽस्मिन् पाण्डुनन्दन। त्वत्तश्चापि प्रियतरा ब्राह्मणा भरतर्षभ॥
en: There is no one, O son of Pandu, in this world, who is dearer to me than you, O chief of Bharats's race, but Brahmans are dearer to me than you.

sa: तान् विद्यावणिजो विद्धि राक्षसानिव भारत। व्याजेन सद्भिर्विहितो धर्मस्ते परिहास्यति॥
en: Consider them, O Bharata, as traders in learning and Rakshasas among men. By the help of mere pretext they renounce that morality, which has been established by good and wise men.

sa: सहजं चिरकारित्वमतिप्रज्ञतया तव। सफलं तत् तथा तेऽस्तु भवाद्य चिरकारिकः॥
en: Ordinarily, on account of your great wisdom you take a long time for reflection before performing any act. Let not you conduct be otherwise to-day! Be you a true Chirakarika to-day.

sa: बाहुभ्यां क्षत्रियशतं वैश्यामानामूरुतः शतम्। पद्भ्यां शूद्रशतं चैव केशवो भरतर्षभ॥
en: From his two arms, he created one hundred Kshatriyas, and from his thighs one hundred. Vaishyas. Then, O foremost of Bharata's racc, Keshava created from his two feet one hundred Shudras.

sa: महापदानि कत्थसे न चाप्यवेक्षसे परम्। चिरस्य मृत्युकारिकामनागतां न बुध्यसे॥
en: You see only the regions of Brahman and other gods, but you cannot see what is the highest. Alas, you are ever blind also to what brings Death on its train.

sa: पतेद् दिवाकरः स्थानाच्छुष्येदपि महोदधिः। शैत्यमग्निरियान त्वां हन्यात् कर्णो धनंजय॥
en: O Dhananjaya, the sun may come down and be displaced, the earth itself may be crushed with a thousand pieces, the fire may become cold but Karna will never kill you.

sa: क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्दैश्च सात्वतेन विदारिताः। क्षरन्तोऽसृक् तथा मूत्रं पुरीषं च प्रदुद्रुवुः॥
en: With Kshurapras and cresscet-shaped arrows, they were then ript open by that hero of the Satvata race. Discharging urine and excreta and shedding blood copiously, they then began to fly away.

sa: अति पाण्डवमाचार्यो द्रोणं चाप्यति पाण्डवः। नानयोरन्तरं शक्यं दुष्टमन्येन केनचित्॥
en: At times the preceptor obtained advantages over the son of Pandu and at times the latter again prevailed over the former. None then was able to mark any difference between them.

sa: तस्थौ वीरो धनुष्पाणिस्तत् सैन्यान्यभ्यपूजयन्।।' ८॥ स मुहूर्तमिवाश्वस्य सदश्वान् समनोदयत्।
en: Then that heroic warrior stood bou in hand, ready once more for fight, sceing which your Warrior applauded him highly. Taking respite for a moment only, Kritavarman urged his stecds on.

sa: ततः स रथनीडस्थं स्वरथस्य रथेषया। अगच्छदसिमुद्यम्य शतचन्द्रं च भानुमत्॥
en: Then jumping down from the terrace of his chariot and riding on the car-shaft he with his sword and bright shield uplifted, tried to approach the latter seated on his chariot.

sa: केचिदन्यत्र गच्छन्तः पथि चान्यैरुपद्रुताः॥ विमुखाः पृष्ठतश्चान्ये ताड्यन्ते पार्श्वतः परे।
en: Some, when going to other parts of the field, were assailed by their foe on the way. Some, in flying away, were wounded on their backs and others on their sides.

sa: तस्मिन्नोरोहति क्षिप्रं स्यन्दने लोकपूजिते॥ शिरोभिरागमन् भूमि ते हया वातरंहसः।
en: Thus while he was immediately ascending that car, which was revered by all persons, those horses, that were as fleet as the wind, bowed down upon the ground with their heads.

sa: शङ्ख च पूरयामास मुहुर्मुहुररिंदमः॥ पार्षतं त्रासयामास महेन्द्रो नमुचिं यथा।
en: That chastiser of foes blew his conch over and over again, and then he routed the son of Prishata, even as Indra routed Namuchi (a Danava, in the battle of old).

sa: जीमूतस्येव धर्मान्ते द्रक्ष्यन्ति युधि सैनिकाः॥ जेष्याम्यद्य रणे पार्थं सायकैर्नतपर्वभिः।
en: My soldiers will behold me like a cloud discharging torrents of rain at the end of the summer. Today I will, by means of straight arrows, conquer the sons of Pritha.

sa: धर्मराजप्रियान्वेषी हत्वा योधान् वरान् वरान्। शूरश्चैव कृतास्रश्च फाल्गुनाभ्येति सात्यकिः॥
en: Having slain numerous warriors all best of their class, the valorous Satyaki ever solicitous of the welfare of Yudhishthira and accomplished in the use of weapons, is approaching you, O Arjuna.

sa: कार्मुकं भ्रामयामास हेमपृष्ठं दुरासदम्। पञ्चालान् निहतान् दृष्ट्वा देवकल्पान् महारथान्॥
en: Began to shake his excellent bow whose staff was golden and which was incapable of being approached. Then beholding those Panchala princes all mighty car-warrior and resembling the Pandavas themselves, slain.

sa: ऋतमेव हि पूर्वास्ते वदन्ति पुरुषोत्तमाः। तस्मादार्तायनिः प्रोक्तो भवानिति मतिर्मम॥
en: Indeed, your ancestors, who were the best of persons, always told the truth; and hence it is my opinion that yourself is said to be the descendant of the truthful persons.

sa: इति कृष्णौ महाबाहू मिथोऽकथयतां तदा। सिन्धुराजमवेक्षन्तौ त्वत्पुत्रा बहु चुकुशुः॥
en: Even so, O mighty-armed one, did the two Krishna's speak amongst themselves while looking for the ruler of the Sindhus. (Hearing what they said) your sons set up a loud wail.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त सहिता भारद्वाजं युयुत्सवः। मुञ्चन्तः शरवर्षाणि तपान्ते जलदा इव॥
en: Unitedly and with a desire for fighting, rushed against the of Bharadvaja, discharging their showers of shafts like so many clouds discharging their contents at the expiration of the summer season.

sa: नीतिमन्तो महेष्वासाः सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः। सैन्धवस्य विधायैवं रक्षां युयुधिरे ततः॥
en: Thus many warriors accomplished in the art of fighting and conversant with the rules of policy, having arranged for the safety of the Sindhu king, went on fighting with the Pandavas.

sa: स्तवात्मजः सत्यसेनश्च वीरः। व्यवस्थितौ चित्रसेनेन सार्ध हृष्टात्मानौ समरे योद्धुकामौ॥
en: Similarly, your sons, Sushena furnished with the sword and shield and the war-like Satyasena are still waiting on the field of battle with joy and desirous of battling for your sake.

sa: यदा त्वसंगृहीतत्वात् प्रयान्त्यश्वा यथासुखम्। ततो दुःशासनः सूतं बुबुधे गतचेतसम्॥
en: The reins being no longer held by any body, the horses ran at their free will. It was only then that Dushasana came to know that his driver had been slain.

sa: भारद्वाजं समासाद्य युयुधानश्च सात्यकिः। न न्यवर्तते संक्रुद्धो वेलामिव जलाशयः॥
en: Then the war-like Satyaki, inflamed as he was with rage, did not recede getting Drona as an opponent, even as the waters of the ocean does not recede encountering an embankment.

sa: प्रयाते रथमास्थाय त्रिपुराभिमुखे भवे। ननाद सुमहानादं वृषभः पूरयन् दिशः॥
en: When Bhaga, riding upon that car, proceeded towards that triple city, his bull (symbol of Bhava) uttered a very excellent and loud roar, filling thereby the different directions with the noise.

sa: सुचित्रश्चित्रवर्मा च पितापुत्रौ महारथौ॥ प्रचरन्तौ महावीरौ द्रोणेन निहतो रणे।
en: The two heroes, possessed of mighty strength, Suchitra and Chitravarman, who are related to each others as father and son, roving about in the field of battle, were slain by Drona.

sa: ततस्तदभवद् युद्धं रथिनां हस्तिभिः सह। सृजतां शरवर्षाणि तोमरांश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: Thereupon, the battle raged between the car-warriors, who were shooting showers of shafts and hurling down thousands of lances, (at the antagonists) and the heroes fighting from the back of elephant.

sa: यच्च तान् पाण्डवान् द्यूते विषमेण विजित्य ह। प्रावाजयस्तदारण्ये रौरवाजिनवाससः॥
en: (This disaster is also the outcome of) your deceit by means of which you defeated the Pandavas at the game of dice and exiled them to the forest clad in deer-skin.

sa: मणिमान् दण्डधारश्च राजानौ युद्धदुर्मदौ॥ पराक्रमन्तौ मित्रार्थे द्रोणेन युधि पातितौ।
en: The two princes, Manimat and Dandadhara, who were incapable of being vanquished in battle and also who exerted themselves with prowess, were, for the sake of their friends, slain by Drona.

sa: तद् युद्धमभवद् राजन् कर्णस्य बहुभिः सह। तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम सूतपुत्रस्य मारिष॥
en: O king, then a terrible battle raged between Karna on one side and the many on the other, then, O sire, we beheld the wonderful prowess of the son of Suta.

sa: सारथिस्तमपोवाह समरे शरविक्षतम्। ततः सा महती सेना प्राद्रवन्निशि भारत॥
en: His charioteer then bore him (i.e. Virata) away who was mangled with arrows in battle. Then, O Bharata, during that night, that large army (of Virata) began to take to flight.

sa: प्रदीपैर्हि परित्यक्तैर्व्वलद्भिस्तैः समन्ततः। व्यराजत मही राजन् वीताभ्रा द्यौरिव ग्रहैः॥
en: In virtue of the (lustre of the) lamps abandoned (by the combatants) and which were burning all around, the field shone resplendent like the cloud-less firmament studded with planets and stars.

sa: घोररूपान् परिक्केशान दुर्योधनकृतान् बहून्। प्रतिज्ञा स्मरता चैव भीमसेनेन पातितः॥
en: He was slain by Bhimasena, who had (at the time) recollected the most severe and innumerable wrongs inflicted upon him by Duryodhana and also the most solemn promise of his own.

sa: संसक्तेषु च योधेषु वर्तमारे च संकुले॥ कबन्धान्युत्थितानि स्युःशतशोऽथ सहस्रशः।
en: In that general encounter, while the warriors were engaged in the battle and continued to be mangled, hundreds and thousands of headless bodies of the fallen warriors) stood upon the field.

sa: ते तथैव दध्मतुः शङ्खौ वासुदेवधनंजयौ। प्रवरौ सर्वदेवानां सर्वशङ्खवरौ भुवि॥
en: Thereupon those two foremost of all gods, viz., Vasudeva and Dhananjaya also blew their conchs that were regarded as the best of all the conchs on the face of the earth.

sa: निशीथे सूतपुत्रेण शरवर्षेण पीडिताः। एते द्रवन्ति पञ्चालाः सिंहेनेवार्दिता मृगाः॥
en: Afflicted at the dead of night with showers of arrows shot by the son of Suta, yonder are the Panchalas flying away like a flock of deer attacked by the lion.

sa: सिंहनादरवाश्चैव प्रादुरासन् समागमे। उभयोः सेनयो राजन् मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: O king! The battle thereafter ensued with a resolution to leave the field only on death in both armies and the warriors began challenging to each other in a loud voice.

sa: स संनिपातो रथयूथपानां बभूव राजन्नतिभीमरूपः। जनक्षयः कालयुगान्तकल्पः प्रावर्तताग्ने कुरसृञ्जयानाम्॥
en: O Bharata king, the encounter of the leading car-warriors was highly wonderful. An onslaught of men like that at the end of a cycle took place before the Kurus and Srinjayas.

sa: क्रोधामर्षविवृत्तास्यो लोहिताक्षो बभौ बली। अन्तकाले यथा क्रुद्धो मृत्युः किङ्करदण्डभृत्॥
en: Full of rage and revengeful spirit the mighty warrior, with his mouth wide open and blood red eyes, looked formidable like Death himself with his terrible mace before a dying person.

sa: ते भीता मृद्यमानाश्च प्रमृष्टा दीर्घबाहुना। आयोधनं जहुर्वीरा दृष्टवा तमतिमानिनम्॥
en: They were then seized with panic being crushed and mangled by that long-armed hero; and beholding that proud hero, they then began to run quickly away from the field of battle,

sa: तं भीमसेनः सम्प्राप्तं वत्सदन्तैः स्तनान्तरे। विव्याध बलवान् क्रुद्धस्तोत्रैरिव महाद्विपम्॥
en: Excited to the highest pitch of rage, the mighty Bhimasena, with several Vatsadantas, pierced Karna on the centre of his chest, like a guide goring a mighty elephant with the hook.

sa: समाहितावप्रतिमप्रभावा वन्योन्यमाजघ्नतुरुत्तमास्त्रैः। तयोर्हि वीरोत्तमयोर्न कश्चिद् ददर्श तस्मिन् समरे विशेषम्॥
en: Of unequaled splendour, they both were each other's match and they then wounded each other with excellent weapons. None could then find any superiority of either of those two excellent heroes.

sa: ते दीप्तजिह्वानलतीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा विभीषणाः शैलनिकाशकायाः। नभोगताः शक्तिविषक्तहस्ता मेघा व्यमुञ्चन्निव वृष्टिमुग्राम्॥
en: Those fierce Rakshasas having fiery tongues, blazing countenances and sharp teeth and forms huge as mountains, car-reering through the sky with lances in grasp, appeared like clouds pouring torrents of rain.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा सोऽनुजज्ञे नृपोत्तमान्। तेऽनुज्ञाता नृपा सर्वे स्वानि वेश्मानि भेजिरे॥
en: Having been thus addressed (by Karna) and saying-so be it, he (Duryodhana) commanded all the best of monarchs to dissolve. All these kings, being thus ordered, repaired to their respective abodes.

sa: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य भारद्वाजसुतं रणे। विरथं विमुखं चैव पुनश्चक्रे महारथः॥
en: Then beholding that son of Bharadvaja's son once wore advance against him in battle, the mighty car-warrior Satyaki once more compelled him to turn away and deprived him of his car.

sa: एष चास्रप्रतीघातं वासुदेवः प्रयुक्तवान्। अन्यथा विहितः संख्ये वधः शत्रोर्जनाधिप॥
en: The son of Vasudeva counter acted the weapon by what means you have seen. For this, O ruler of men, the extermination of the foe has not been accomplished in battle.

sa: ते शरैर्भिन्नमर्माणो रथेभ्यः प्रापतन् क्षितौ। गिरिसानुरुहा भग्ना द्विपेनेव महाद्रुमाः॥
en: With their armour shattered by those arrows, your sons then fell down from their cars on the earth, like tall trees growing on the slopes of mountains, broken down by elephants.

sa: कृष्णाश्च स्रष्टा जगतो रथं तमभिरक्षति। एतैर्द्रव्यैरहं हीनो योद्धुमिच्छामि पाण्डवम्॥
en: Moreover Krishna, who is the creator of the universe, most carefully guards that car. I am destitute of all these equipments, yet I wish to fight with the son of Pandu.

sa: जिघांसुर्धार्तराष्ट्रश्च श्रान्तेष्वश्वेषु फाल्गुनम्। कवचेन तथा गुप्तो रक्षार्थं सैन्धवस्य च॥
en: This preceptor gave an impenetrable armour to Duryodhana, when all other warriors were worn out with fatigue, in order that the latter may slay Phalguna and effect the protection of Jayadratha.

sa: कश्चिद् वाहीकदुष्टानां नातिहष्टमना जगौ। सा नूनं बृहती गौरी सूक्ष्मकम्बलवासिनी॥
en: "Surely that big and fair (Balhika maiden) dressed in her blankets is thinking of me her Balhika lover, who am living in Kurujangala at the time of her going to bed.

sa: चक्रं व्यसृजदत्युग्रं तेषां नाशाय केशवः। तेनार्ता जातयः क्षुद्राः सदानवनिशाचराः॥
en: The dwellers of that forest, including the Danavas and the Rakshasas, were struck by that weapon; and being cut into hundred of pieces, they fill into the mouth of Agni (fire).

sa: सर्वास्त्रेषु स निष्णान्तः पार्थिवेष्वितरेषु च। महाबलो महासत्त्वो महावीर्यो महारथः॥
en: He was expert in all sorts of weapons belonging to heaven and earth. He was greatly strong and vastly energetic; he was a great carwarrior; and he was a great beauty.

sa: विनतोवाच यस्ते कण्ठमनुप्राप्तो निगीर्णं बडिशं यथा। दहेदङ्गारवत्पुत्र तं विद्याद्राह्मणर्षभम्॥
en: Vinata said: O son, know him to be a Brahmana who will torture you like a fishhook, or burn you like a hot charcoal, when he will enter into your throat.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा प्रीयमाणाः समेता तत्रासन्पन्नगा वीतमोहाः। रूचुश्चै वरमिष्टं वृणीष्व॥
en: Having heard all he said, those snakes, that assembled there, were much delighted and their fear was dispelled. They were greatly pleased with Astika and insisted him to ask a boon.

sa: इदं हि वेदैः समितं पवित्रमपि चोत्तमम्। श्राव्याणामुत्तमं चेदं पुराणमृषिसंस्तुतम्॥
en: This (Bharata) is equal to the Vedas; it is holy and excellent; it is the worthiest of all that should be listened to. It is a Purana, adored by the Rishis.

sa: गिरिव्रजे निरुद्धानां राज्ञां कृष्णेन मोक्षणम्। तथा दिग्विजयोऽत्रैव पाण्डवानां प्रकीर्तितः॥
en: The deliverance by Krishna of all the princes those were kept as prisoners (by Jarasandha) at (his capital city) Girivraja, Then it relates the conquest of the world by the Pandavas;

sa: पुरुषं विश्वकर्माणं सत्त्वयोगं ध्रुवाक्षरम्। अनन्तमचलं देवं हंसं नारायणं प्रभुम्॥
en: He is the Purusha, the Creator himself, he is the centre of Satya Guna, he is infinite, he is incapable of being moved, he is the deity, he is Lord Narayana;

sa: कच्चित् सर्वेऽनुरक्तास्त्वां कुलपुत्राः प्रधानतः! कच्चित् प्राणांस्तवार्थेषु संत्यजन्ति सदा युधि॥
en: Are all the chief men (of your kingdom) nobly born? Are they all attached to you? Are they ready to give their lives cheerfully for you on the field of battle?

sa: वीटां च मुद्रिकां चैव ह्यहमेतदपि द्वयम्। उद्धरेयमिषीकाभिर्भोजनं मे प्रदीयताम्॥
en: "If you give me a dinner, I shall with these blades of glass bring up not only the ball you have lost, but also this ring which I now throw down."

sa: तस्य पुत्रौ महावी? जातौ भीमपराक्रमौ। सुन्दोपसुन्दौ दैत्येन्द्रौ दारुणौ क्रूरमानसौ॥
en: Two sons were born to him, named Sunda and Upasunda, both of them being chiefs of the Danavas and both of them being very energetic and powerful, very fearful and wicked-minded.

sa: कथं च बहुला: सेनाः पाण्डवः कृष्णसारथिः। अस्यन्नेकोऽनयत्सर्वाः पितृलोकं धनंजयः॥
en: Why did the son of Pandu, Arjuna, Krishna himself being his charioteer and who could by his arrows send to the other world hosts of fighting men, suffer so many persecutions?

sa: छित्त्वानेकानि सत्त्वानि पाणिमेति पुनः पुनः। तथा तु निघ्नतस्तस्य पिशाचोरगराक्षसान्॥
en: While he was thus engaged in killing the Pishachas, the Nagas and the Rakshasas, the face and the feature of Krishna, the soul of all creatures, became fearful to look at.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इति शप्त्वाऽतिसंक्रुद्धः शृंगी पितरमभ्यगात्। आसीनं गोव्रजे तस्मिन्वहन्तं शवपन्नगम्॥
en: Sauti said: Having thus cursed the king from anger, Shringi went to his father and saw that he was sitting in the cow-shed, the dead snake (was still) on his shoulder.

sa: कृतं युवाभ्यां कर्मेदममरैरपि दुष्करम्। वरं वृणीतं तुष्टांऽस्मि दुर्लभं पुरुषेष्विह॥
en: “You have achieved a feat that even a celestial can never do. Ask each of you a boon that is not obtainable by man. I am very much pleased with you”.

sa: सौतिरुवाच ततस्तस्मिन्द्विजश्रेष्ठ समुदीर्णे तथाविधे। गरुडः पक्षिराट् तूर्णं संप्राप्तो विबुधान्प्रति॥
en: Sauti said : O best of the twice born, the celestials, having stood prepared for battle (in he way already narrated), the king of the birds Garuda soon came upon them.

sa: तमग्निः प्रार्थयामास दिधक्षुर्वातसारथिः॥ शरीरवाञ्जटी भूत्वा नदन्निव बलाहकः। श्रुत्वा मा
en: Agni, whose charioteer was the wind, immediately assuming a body with (fiery) matted looks on his head and roaring like the clouds, pursued the Asura with the intention of consuming him.

sa: ततो राज्ञः कुलद्वारि प्रसुप्तमिव तं नृपम्। रात्रौ गतासुमुत्सृज्य निश्चक्रमररिंदमाः॥
en: The chastiser of foes (Krishna) left at night the dead body of the king at the palace gate, as if he was but asleep. They then came out (of the palace).

sa: वृथारोषप्रतिज्ञो वै नाहं भवितुमुत्सहे। अनिस्तीर्णो हि मां रोषो दहेदग्निरिवारणिम्॥
en: I cannot to be one whose anger and vows are fruitless. This my anger will certainly consume me (if I do not accomplish my vow), as fire consumes the dry wood.

sa: वेदे धनुषि चाचार्यमभिजानामि तेऽर्जुना विश्रुतं त्रिषु लोकेषु भारद्वाजं यशस्विनम्॥
en: O Arjuna, I personally know your preceptor, the illustrious son of Bharadvaja (Drona), who is celebrated in the three worlds for his learning in the Vedas and the science of archery.

sa: तथाऽसुरा गिरिभिरदीनचेतसो मुहुर्मुहुः सरगणमादयस्तदा। महाबला विगलितमेघवर्चसः सहस्रशो गगनमभिप्रपद्य ह॥
en: The greatly powerful and bold Danavas, looking like the rainless clouds, rose to the sky and continually hurled down thousands of mountains, on the celestials, thus harassing them (with terrible vengeance).

sa: प्रसह्य हरणं चापि क्षत्रियाणां प्रशस्यते। विवाहहेतुः शूराणामिति धर्मविदो विदुः॥
en: The men learned in the precepts of religion say that in the case of heroic Kshatriyas, a forcible taking away of a girl for the purpose of marriage is also praiseworthy.

sa: पाद्यार्थ्याचमनीयैस्तं स्वागतेन च भारत। तथैव परिजग्राह वन्येन हविषा तदा॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he (Vasishtha) worshipped him (Vishvamitra) by asking his welfare, by offering Arghya and water to wash his face and feet and by collected forest fruits and ghee.

sa: स कृष्णं मलदिग्धाङ्गं कृष्णाजिनजटाधरम्। नैषादिं श्वा समालक्ष्य भषंस्तस्थौ तदन्तिक॥
en: The dog seeing the Nishada of dark colour and of body besmeared with filth, with an attire of black skin and with matted hair on his head, began to bark aloud.

sa: मुत्थापयामास मृतं कचोऽपि। विद्यां सिद्धां तामवाप्याभिवाद्य ततः कचस्तं गुरुमित्युवाच॥
en: Seeing the remains of his preceptor lying like a heap of ascetic virtues and learning, Kacha revived him with the knowledge he had received. He then spoke to the preceptor thus-

sa: कच्चिद् दारान्मनुष्याणां तवार्थे मृत्युमीयुषाम्। व्यसनं चाभ्युपेतानां बिभर्षि भरतर्षभ।। ५५
en: O best of the Bharata race, do you support the wives and children of those that have given their lives for you, and those that have fallen into distress for you?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तस्यैतन्मतमाज्ञाय सत्यधर्मपरायणः। प्रत्यजानात् तदा राजन् पितुः प्रियचिकीर्षया॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, the devotee of religion of truth,(Devavrata), knowing the scruple of the fisherman and being moved by the desire of doing good to his father then said.

sa: अस्तिः प्राप्तिश्च नाम्ना ते सहदेवानुजेऽबले। बलेन तेन स्वज्ञातीनभिभूय वृथामतिः॥
en: They are named Asti and Prapti and they are the sisters of Sahadeva. Strengthened by such an alliance, the fool (Kansa) persecuted his relatives and gained an ascendancy over them all.

sa: अर्वानिशीथात् परतस्त्वया सार्धं वदिष्यतः। यज्ञागारे स्थापयित्वा राजा राजगृहं गतः॥
en: They will remain silent till midnight. After that hour they will talk with you." The king quartered them in the sacrificial apartments, and he then went to his own royal apartments.

sa: इह मासं प्रतीक्षध्वमागमिष्याम्यहं पुनः। देशकालौ विदित्वैव लप्स्यध्वं परमां मुदम्॥
en: “Wait here for me. I shall come back to you. You will be able to obtain great happiness by adopting yourself to the place and time (in which you are now).”

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तथा शैलनिपातेन भीषिताः खाण्डवालयाः। दानवा राक्षसा नागास्तरक्ष्वृक्षवनौकसः॥ द्विपाः प्रभिन्नाः शार्दूलाः सिंहाः केसरिणस्तथा। मृगाश्च महिषाश्चैव शतशः पक्षिणस्तथा॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The dwellers of the Khandava the Danavas, the Rakshasas, the Nagas the wolves and the bears, the other wild animals, the elephants with their temples rent, the tigers, the lions with manes, hundred of deer and buffaloes, birds and various other creatures, all being frightened by the falling stones and afflicted with anxiety, began to fly in all directions.

sa: जरासंधरथं कृष्णो योजयित्वा पताकिनम्। आरोप्य भ्रातरौ चैव मोक्षयामास बान्धवान्॥
en: Krishna made ready the chariot of Jarasandha with the excellent standard and he then placed on it the two brothers (Bhima and Arjuna). He then liberated the friends (the captive kings).

sa: विकर्षन्तौ महावेगौ गर्जमानौ परस्परम्। पश्यैवं युधि विक्रान्तावेतौ च नरराक्षसौ॥
en: Behold the man and the Rakshasas, both endued with great strength and prowess, (now) engaged in combat, pressing each other with great force and filling the whole region with their roars.

sa: तेन मुक्ता जतुगृहानिशीथे प्राद्रवन्वनम्। ततः संप्राप्य कौन्तेया नगरं वारणावतम्॥
en: Being saved through him from the house of lac, they fled at the dead of night to a deep forest. They, the sons of Kunti, came to a city, called Varanavata;

sa: कांश्चिदुत्पततः पार्थः शरैः संछिद्य खण्डशः। पातयामास विहगान् प्रदीप्ते वसुरेतसि॥
en: The birds that took to their wings to escape from that fire were soon pierced by Arjuna's arrows; and being cut down to pieces, they again fell into the burning fire.

sa: अङ्गुलीयकदानं च ऋक्षस्य बिलदर्शनम्। प्रायोपवेशनं चैव सम्पातेश्चापि दर्शनम् ॥
en: The making over of his ring by Rāma to Hanuman; Rksa's discovery of the cave. The abstemious abode of the monkeys on the shore of the ocean; Hanuman's interview with Sampāti.

sa: मम स्नेहाच्च सौहार्दादिदमुक्तं त्वा वचः॥ परितुष्टोऽस्म्यहं सीते न ह्यनिष्टोऽनुशास्यते।
en: You have spoken this to me through affection and friendship. I have been well pleased with you, O Sītā. One did not instruct another that one did not bear affection to.

sa: इत्युक्तः करुणं वाक्यं वानरैस्त्यक्तजीवितैः। सवाष्पो वानरान् गृध्रः प्रत्युवाच महास्वनः॥
en: When the monkeys, whose lives had well nigh departed out of them, had spoken these piteous words, the vulture, in solemn accents, with tears in his eyes, said to the monkeys,

sa: त्रिशङ्को गच्छ भूयस्त्वं नासि स्वर्गकृतालयः॥ गुरुशापहतो मूढ पत भूमिमवाक्शिराः।
en: O Trisanku, turn you back. You have not earned abode in heaven. O fool, you have been blighted by the curse of your spiritual guide. Do you therefore drop down headlong.

sa: तस्यापि हि भवेदस्मिन् कर्मण्यप्रतिसंहते। सत्यं नेति मनस्तापस्तस्य तापस्तपेच्च माम्॥
en: If this work of installation be not stopped, my father shall be greatly pained at heart thinking that his vows shall not be fulfilled and his sorrow will also ache me.

sa: शोचन्त्याश्चाल्पभाग्याया न किंचिदुपकुर्वता। पुत्रेण किमपुत्राया मया कार्यमरिंदम॥ अल्पभाग्या हि मे माता कौसल्या रहिता मया। शेते परमदुःखार्ता पतिता शोकसागरे॥
en: What am I, O repressor of foes, now to do for her, bewailing, of slender fortune, she that has not profited in the least by her son, and who stands in no further need of his good offices ? Surely my unfortunate mother, Kausalyā, bereft of me, lies down on the ground, overwhelmed with woe, and plunged in an ocean of grief..

sa: तदेवं प्रस्तुते कार्ये कार्यमस्माभिरुत्तरम्। तत् कार्यं कार्यतत्त्वज्ञे त्वमुदाहर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: And, therefore, he does not abide by the virtue of preserving friendship. O you expert in business, this being the case, do you advice us as to what we should do.

sa: समृद्धार्थस्य सिद्धार्था मुदितामलवर्णिनि। आर्यस्य त्वं विशालाक्षि भार्या भव यवीयसी॥
en: O you of expansive eyes, be you securing the sumimum bonum, with a joyful heart, become, O superbly beautiful wench, the younger wife of the noble one of great good fortune.

sa: राजपुत्रि श्रुतं त्वेतन्मुनेरस्य समीरितम्। श्रेयोऽर्थमात्मनः शीघ्रमभिगच्छ तपस्विनीम्॥ अनसूयेति या लोके कर्मभिः ख्यातिमागता। तां शीघ्रमभिगच्छ त्वमभिगम्यां तपस्विनीम्॥
en: O princess, you have heard what has been uttered by the ascetic. For the sake of your own welfare, do you speedily resort to the female anchoret. Do you without delay resort to the ascetic Anasuya, who is worthy of being associated with, and who has by virtue of her acts attained renown among men.f

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु व्रतस्नातं महामुनिम्। अभ्यगच्छन् सुराः सर्वे तप:फलचिकीर्षवः॥
en: When the thousand years had been completed and the mighty ascetic had accomplished his vow, the celestials in a body desirous of conferring upon him the fruit thereof, appeared before him.

sa: सुदुष्टस्त्वं वने राममेकमेकोऽनुगच्छसि। मम हेतोः प्रतिच्छन्नः प्रयुक्तो भरतेन वा॥
en: Verily are you a monster of wickedness, that Rāma repairing to woods, you have, being lustful for me, followed him alone. Or hast you been engaged by Bharata to act thus?

sa: तस्मादाहारवीर्येण निसर्गेण च वानराः। आयोजनशताद् साग्राद् वयं पश्याम नित्यशः॥
en: For this reason, as well as owing to the energy consequent on our feeding on certain kinds of flesh, we, you monkeys, can see a little further than an hundred Yojanas.

sa: ब्रह्मन् न प्रतिजानीमो नास्तिको जायते जनः। सम्मूढमिव त्रैलोक्यं सम्प्रक्षुभितमानसम्॥
en: O Brahmana, we do not know how to remedy, this. And every one is inactive like an infidel. And the three worlds look as if stupefied, with their minds exceedingly exercised.

sa: ततस्तु तस्मिन् विजने महाबलौ महावने राघववंशबर्धनौ। र्यथैव सिंहौ गिरिसानुगोचरौ॥
en: Then like to a couple of lions dwelling on a mountain-summit, at that lone spot of the extensive forest, those powerful perpetuators of the Raghu race, began to dwell without fear.

sa: अतिप्रवृत्ते दुर्मेधे कैकेयि कुलपांसनि। वञ्चयित्वा तु राजानं न प्रमाणेऽवतिष्ठसि॥
en: O you whose desires outrun your sense of honour, O you of perverted understanding, O befouler of your line, deceiving the monarch, you stay not within the pale of the promise.

sa: नूनं जात्यन्तरे तात स्त्रियः पुत्रैर्वियोजिताः। जनन्या मम सौमित्रे तदद्यैतदुपस्थितम्॥
en: Surely, O child, in a former birth, women were bereft of their sons by my mother, O son of Sumitrā; and it is for this that this misfortune has befallen her.

sa: यावद् राजा प्रियं पुत्रं पश्यत्यत्यन्तधार्मिकम्। तावद् व्यवर्धतेवास्य धरण्यां पुत्रदर्शने॥
en: And so long as the king could discover his exceedingly virtuous and favourite son, so long he raised himself (on his toes) on the earth with the view of beholding him.

sa: तं प्रत्युवाच कैकेयी प्रियवद् घोरमप्रियम्। अजानन्तं प्रजानन्ती राज्यलोभेन मोहिता॥
en: Blinded by the lust of dominion, and looking upon that as desirable (to Bharata) which was exceedingly disagreeable (to him), Kaikeyi replied to him, who did not know what had transpired.

sa: प्रयागमभितः पश्य सौमित्रे धूममुत्तमम्। अग्नेर्भगवतः केतुं मन्ये संनिहितो मुनिः॥
en: O son of Sumitrā, do you behold the beautiful wreath of smoke that rises in front of Prayāga, sign of the worshipful Fire, and I infer some ascetic to be near.

sa: नाददानं शरान् घोरान् विमुञ्चन्तं शरोत्तमान्। विकर्षमाणं पश्यन्ति राक्षसास्ते शरार्दिताः॥
en: And those Rākṣasas, afflicted with arrows could not see Rāma how he took out his dread shafts, nor how he discharged those excellent shafts; they only saw him drawing his bow.

sa: पुरस्तादिह वातापिः परिभूय तपस्विनः। उदरस्थो द्विजान् हन्ति स्वगर्भोऽश्वतरीमिव ॥
en: Formerly this Vātăpi entering into the womb of twice-born ones used to come out reaving them like to the embryo of a mule. The name of an Asur devoured by Agastya.

sa: अथान्धकारे त्वौषं जले कुम्भस्य पूर्यतः। अचक्षुर्विषये घोषं वारणस्येव नर्दतः॥
en: And (coming there) while it was so dark that : nothing could be discovered, I heard sounds of a filling pitcher proceeding from the waters; resembling the roars of an elephant.

sa: प्रसन्नमुखवर्णश्च व्यक्तं हृष्टश्च भाषते। नानृतं वक्ष्यते वीरो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः॥
en: He speaketh openly with a delightful light in his countenance; and cheerfulness. (It seems) that the heroic Hanuman, son to the God of wind does not speak anything that is false.

sa: यन्मे धनं च रत्नं च ददौ राजा परंतपः। परिश्रान्तं पथ्यभवत् ततोऽहं पूर्वमागतः॥ राजवाक्यहरैर्दूतैस्त्वर्यमाणोऽहमागतः। यदहं प्रष्टुमिच्छामि तदम्बा वक्तुमर्हति ॥
en: My vehicles had got tired in consequence of bearing the wealth and jewels which that subduer of foes, the king, had bestowed on me. And it is for this reason that I have come in advance of them. Urged by the royal emissaries, I have come here so swiftly. But it behoves my mother to tell me what I wish to ask.

sa: मयि ते यद्यनुक्रोशो यदि रक्षःसु तेषु च। रामेण यदि शक्तिस्ते तेजो वास्ति निशाचर॥ दण्डकारण्यनिलयं जहि राक्षसकण्टकम्।
en: If you have any kindness for me as well as those sons of Rākşasas* and, O ranger of night, if you have strength and energy to cope with Rāma, do you kill this thorn of the Rákşasas, who has set up his dwelling in the forest of Dandaka. Another reading is that enemy of mine.

sa: पानीयदूषके पापं तथैव विषदायके। यत्तदेकः स लभतां यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile into the woods of that noble one come by the sin that attaches to a wine biber or one that administers poison to another!

sa: उत्सादयति लोकांस्त्रीन् स्त्रियश्चाप्युपकर्षति। तस्मात् तस्य वधो दृष्टो मानुषेभ्यः परंतप॥
en: He commits ravages upon the three worlds and carries away the fair sex by violence. Therefore, O subduer of enemies, we have even fixed upon man for bringing about his death.

sa: उपलब्धं च मे श्लाघ्यं सन्मित्रं मित्रवत्सल। त्वामहं पुरुषव्याघ्र हिमवन्तमिवाश्रितः॥
en: And having secured in you a worthy and sincere friend, O best of men, O you that are loving to your friends, I have taken your shelter like to Himăvat himself.

sa: तत् सरः समतिक्रम्य नष्टचन्द्रदिवाकरम्। अनक्षत्रगणं व्योम निष्पयोदमनादितम् ॥ गभस्तिभिरिवार्कस्य स तु देशः प्रकाश्यते। विश्राम्यद्भिस्तपः सिद्धैर्देवकल्पैः स्वयंप्रभैः॥
en: Going beyond that expanse of water, (you come upon) a sky void of stars, and where the sun and the moon have been put out; and that land is visible by the rays, as if of the sun, proceeding from (the persons of) self-luminous, god-like ones, who are reposing there, after achieving success in austerities.

sa: चपलश्चपलैः सार्धं वानरैरकृतात्मभिः। जात्यन्ध इव जात्यन्धैर्मन्त्रयन् प्रेक्षसे नु किम्॥
en: Fickle as you are, how canst you comprehend what is proper, consulting with your monkey companions who are equally stupid and lighthearted, like to one, born blind, leading with another such?

sa: मलंकृतं तं सुतमाव्रजन्तम्। नन्दामि पश्यन्निव दर्शनेन भवामि दृष्ट्वैव पुनर्युवेव॥
en: When I hear him coming, adorned like to a son of the celestials, I rejoice on casting my eyes on him, and I feel as if I had regained my youth.

sa: मुखेन शस्त्रपत्रेण ये मनुष्या: प्रधानतः। भवन्तं तेऽनुयास्यन्ति महेन्द्रमिव देवताः॥
en: Those amongst men who will become the foremost of all in the use of weapons and in riding animals, and other conveyances, shall go behind you like the deities behind Indra.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राजवृत्तान्यनेकानि त्वया प्रोक्तानि भारत। पूर्वैः पूर्वनियुक्तानि राजधर्मार्थवेदिभिः॥१॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have, O Bharata, described the many duties of king-craft, which were observed and laid down in days of yore by persons of ancient times conversant with royal duties.

sa: यो वै जयत्यधर्मेण क्षत्रियो धर्मसंगरः॥ आत्मानमात्मना हन्ति पापो निकृतिजीवनः।
en: If a Kshatriya, whose duty is to fight fairly, wins a victory by unfair means, he incurs sin thereby. Of deceitful conduct, such a person is said to destroy his ownself.

sa: रथः शरीरं भूतानां सत्त्वमाहुस्तु सारथिम्। इन्द्रियाणि हयानाहुः कर्मबुद्धिस्तु रश्मयः॥
en: The body of a creature is called the car. The vital principle is the driver of that car. The senses are the horses. Our acts and the understanding are the traces.

sa: तस्मान्निषादाः सम्भूताः क्रूराः शैलवनाश्रयाः। ये चान्ये विन्ध्यनिलया म्लेच्छाः शतसहस्रशः॥
en: From him have originated the Nishadas, viz., those wicked tribes who live in the hills and the forests, as also those hundreds and thousands of Mlechchhas, living on the Vindhya ranges.

sa: वायव्यश्चाथ कौमार्यो ब्राह्मयश्च भरतर्षभ॥ वैष्णव्यश्च तथा सौर्यो वाराह्यश्च महाबलाः।
en: And some were of the nature of Vayu, some of Kumara, some of Brahman, O foremost of Bharatas, race and some of Vishnu and some of Surya and some of Varaha.

sa: यश्चात्र धर्मो नित्योक्तो दण्डनीतिव्यपाश्रयः तमशङ्कः करिष्यामि स्ववशो न कदाचन॥
en: Do you also swear that you would fearlessly follow the duties laid down in the Vedas with the help of the science of punishment, and that you would never act capriciously.

sa: त्त्वं पुनः प्राज्ञरूप: सन् कृपणं परितप्यसे। अकाम्यान् कामयानोऽर्थान् पराधीनानुपद्रवान्॥
en: You seem to be endued with wisdom. Why, then, do you grieve so piteously, seeking for things which should not be sought for, since they are unstable and dependent on others?

sa: राजा दुर्योधनो नाम सखास्य भविता नृषु। तस्य स्नेहावबद्धोऽसौ ब्राह्मणानवमंस्यते॥
en: There will be a king of the name of Duryodhana. Among men, he will be the friend of this creature. Out of affection towards him, the Rakshasa will insult the Brahmanas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तूष्णीम्भूतं तु राजानं पुनरेवार्जुनोऽब्रवीत्। संतप्तः शोकदुःखाभ्यां राजवाक्छल्यपीडितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said When after saying these words, Yudhishthira became silent, Arjuna, pained by that speech of the king, and burning with sorrow and grief, once more said to his eldest brother,

sa: प्रीयते हि हरन् पापः परवित्तमराजके। यदास्य उद्धरन्त्यन्ये तदा राजानमिच्छति॥
en: During times of anarchy, the sinful man enjoys by robbing the wealth of other people. When however, his ill acquired riches are taken away by others, he wishes for a king.

sa: विजित्य क्षममाणस्य यशो राज्ञो विवर्धते। महापराधे हाप्यस्मिन् विश्वसन्त्यपि शत्रवः॥
en: The fame of a king who shows forgiveness after conquest spreads more widely. The very enemies of a forgiving person trust him even when he becomes guilty of a heinous crime.

sa: स्त्रीशूद्रं पतितं चापि नाभिभाषेद् व्रतान्वितः पापान्यज्ञानतः कृत्वा मुच्येदेवंव्रतो द्विजः॥
en: Practising rigid vows, he should abstain from speaking with women, Shudras, and degraded persons. A Brahmana by observing such rules may be freed off of all sins unconsciously committed by him.

sa: देशधर्मांच कौन्तेय कुलधर्मांस्तथैव च। पालयन् पुरुषव्याघ्र राजा सर्वाश्रमी भवेत्॥
en: A king, O son of Kunti, by following the duties of his country and those of his family, acquires, O foremost of men the merits of all the modes of life.

sa: स्वरेण हृष्टपुष्टेन तुष्टाव मधुसूदनम्॥ योगेश्वरं पद्मनाभं विष्णुं जिष्णुं जगत्पतिम्।
en: With a cheerful and strong voice he sang the encomium of the destroyer of Madhu, that lord of Yoga, the lotus-navelled deity, that lord of the universe, called Vishnu and Jishnu.

sa: प्रियो भवति दानेन प्रियवादेन चापरः॥ मन्त्रहोमजपैरन्यः कार्यार्थं प्रीयते जनः।
en: One becomes dear for his liberality. Another becomes dear for his sweet words. A third becomes so for his religious acts. Generally, a person becomes dear for the purpose he serves.

sa: ततो विमर्दः सुमहान् राज्ञामासीद् युयुत्सताम्। संनह्यतां तनुत्राणि रथान् योजयतामपि॥
en: A great tumult then took place among the kings, all the whom were bent upon fighting.-Put on your coats of mail. Get the cars ready!-(These were the words that were heard).

sa: हतपुत्रा हि गान्धारी निहतज्ञातिबान्धवा॥ प्रज्ञाचक्षुश्च दुर्धर्षः कां गति प्रतिपत्स्यते।
en: Alas, what will be the condition of Gandhari who is now childless, and who had lost all her kinsmen and relatives what also will be the condition of the blind king.

sa: तोयकर्मणि तं कुन्ती कथयामास सूर्यजम्। पुत्रं सर्वगुणोपेतमवकीर्णं जले पुरा॥
en: Whilst we were offering oblations of water to the dead, Kunti described him as the son of Surya (Sun-God). Possessed of every accomplishment, that child had been thrown into the water.

sa: प्रियं ब्रूयादकृपणः शूरः स्यादविकत्थनः। दाता नापात्रवर्षी स्यात् प्रगल्भः स्यादनिष्ठुरः॥
en: He should cheerfully speak out what is pleasant, and be brave without brag. He should be liberal, but should not make gifts to unworthy persons. He should exercise power without cruelty.

sa: अर्हान् पूजयतो नित्यं संविभागेन पाण्डव। सर्वतस्तस्य कौन्तेय भैक्ष्याश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king, who always adores those who are worthy of adorations by having paid them their due, attains, O son of Kunti, to the object of the Bhaikshya mode of life.

sa: सर्वतेजोमयं दिव्यं विमानवरमास्थितम्। उपर्युपरि गच्छन्तं स्वं वै सेनापतिं प्रभुम्॥
en: The king saw his powerful general shining with every kind of energy, gifted with celestial forin, seated on a very beautiful car, and going up and up towards still higher regions.

sa: आह्निकं जपमानस्य देवान् पूजयतः सदा। धर्मेण पुरुषव्याघ्र धर्माश्रमपदं भवेत्॥
en: That king silently recites his mantras every day and who adores the gods according to the ordinance, attains, O foremost of men, to the object of the Garhasthya mode of life.

sa: युध्यमानं हि कौन्तेयं हनिष्यामि न संशयः। नोत्सहेन्मातिक्रान्तुं वेलामिव महोदधिः॥
en: If I fight in the rear of my army forsooth the son of Kunti will not be able to approach me as the ocean is unable to go beyond its banks.

sa: स वार्यमाणो नास्माकमकार्षीर्वचनं तदा। पाण्डवानधिकाञ्जानन् बले शौर्ये च कौरव॥
en: Although requested by us, you did not act according to the advice we offered, knowing that the Pandavas were superior to you and yours, O Kuru chief in strength and bravery!

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच राजा राज्यमनुप्राप्य दुर्लभं भरतर्षभ। अमित्रस्यातिवृद्धस्य कथं तिष्ठेदसाधनः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Tell me, O foremost of Bharata's race, how a king, without the usual helps, having obtained a kingdom which is so valuable a possession, should treat a powerful enemy.

sa: स्वयमुत्पादयित्वागिनं वस्त्रेण परिवेष्टयन्। दह्यमानो मनस्तापं भजते न स पण्डितः॥
en: The man who keeps a burning coal within the folds of his cloth and is burnt by the fire thereof is surely called a fool if he grieves for his injuries.

sa: बाणवद्विसृता यान्ति स्वामिकार्यपरा नराः। ये भृत्याः पार्थिवहितास्तेषां सान्त्वं प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: Those men who are devoted to the master proceed unimpeded like arrows. Kings should always speak sweet words to those servants who are always busy with doing good to their masters.

sa: सत्कृतोऽहं त्वया मित्र सामर्थ्यादात्मनः सखे। स मां मित्रत्वमापन्नमुपभोक्तुं त्वमर्हसि॥
en: I have been, O friend, respected and served by you to the best of your power. You should now enjoy the company of my poor self who has become your friend.

sa: हीनकोशं हि राजानमवजानन्ति मानवाः। न चास्याल्पेन तुष्यन्ति कार्यमप्युत्सहन्ति च॥
en: All men disregard a king, who has an empty treasury. Without being pleased with the little that such a king can give, his servants never show any zeal in his business.

sa: न तान् रथस्थो भूमिष्ठान् धर्मापेक्षी वृकोदरः। योधयामास कौन्तेयो भुजवीर्यव्यपाश्रयः॥
en: Following the rules of a fair fight, Kunti's son Vrikodara alighted from his car and depending upon the strength of his own arms he began to fight with them on foot.

sa: धर्मराजं परिष्वज्य सान्त्वयित्वा च भारत। दुष्टात्मा भीममन्वैच्छद् दिधक्षुरिव पावकः॥
en: Having embraced Yudhishthira and spoken a few solacing words to him, O Bharata, the wicked Dhritarashtra sought for Bhima, like a burning fire ready to burn everything that would approach it.

sa: न त्वेव जाल्मी कापाली वृत्तिमेषितुमर्हसि। नृशंसवृत्तिं पापिष्ठां दुष्टां कापुरुषोचिताम्॥
en: It is not proper that such a man should follow a deceitful life of mendicancy, a life that is sinful and wicked and cruel and which benefits only a human wretch.

sa: वेदितव्यानि मित्राणि विज्ञेयाश्चापि शत्रवः। एतत् सुसूक्ष्मं लोकेऽस्मिन् दृश्यते प्राज्ञसम्मतम्॥
en: Friends should be well tried. Enemies also should be well studied. In this world, a task like this is considered by even the learned as a difficult one requiring sharp intelligence.

sa: किमाश्चर्यं च यन्मूढो धर्मकामोऽप्यधर्मवित्। सुमहत् प्राप्नुयात् पुण्यं गङ्गायामिव कौशिकः॥
en: How extraordinary it is that a foolish person though desirous of winning merit still perpetrated a sinful deed! An owl, again, living on the banks of the Ganges, acquired great merit.

sa: सत्कृतं स्वजनेनेह परोऽपि बहु मन्यते। स्वजनेन त्ववज्ञातं परे परिभवन्त्युत॥
en: One who is respected by his own people becomes an object of esteem with his enemies also, while one who is disregarded by his own is set at naught by enemies.

sa: खानयामास यः कोपात् पृथिवीं सागराङ्किताम्। यस्य नाम्ना समुद्रश्च सागरत्वमुपागतः॥
en: Out of wrath that king made the Earth to be excavated, whereupon she came to have the ocean on her bosom, and, therefore, the ocean is called Sagara after his name.

sa: मुत्थाय दीना पुनरेव चैषा। कर्णस्य वक्त्रं परिजिघ्रमाणा रोरूयते पुत्रवधाभितप्ता॥
en: Falling down on the ground the cheerless lady is rising up again. Filled with grief for the death of her son also, she comes and smelleth the face of her husband.

sa: शरभोऽन्प्यतिसंहष्टो नित्यं प्राणिवधे रतः॥ फलमूलाशनं कर्तुं नैच्छत् स पिशिताशनः।
en: Filled with delight, the Sharabha continued daily to kill animals for his food. Metamorphosed into a carnivorous beast, he no longer liked fruits and roots upon which he had lived before.

sa: तथा पिण्याकसम्मिश्रमशनं चोरयेन्नरः। स जायते बभ्रुसमो दारुणो मूषिको नरः॥
en: That man who steals food mixed with sesame cakes is in his next birth born as a mouse large or small according to the largeness or smallness of the quantity stolen.

sa: पर्युपासनकाले तु विपरीतं विधीयते। आमर्दकाले राजेन्द्र व्यपसर्पेत् ततः परम्॥
en: You should march against an enemy who is not provided with contented and healthy combatants. When everything's is favourable, the enemy may be beaten. After that however, the victor should retire.

sa: तथैव विप्रप्रवरान् नमस्कृत्य यतव्रताः। भवन्ति ये दानरता दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: They who adore the foremost of Brahmanas with reverence and are firm in the observance of excellent vows and practise the virtue of charity succeed in crossing all calamities and impediments.

sa: स हि कृष्ण महातेजाः श्लाघन्निव ममाग्रतः॥ बालभावेन विनयमात्मनोऽकथयत् प्रभुः।
en: He was possessed, O Krishna, of great energy. From a spirit of childishness, that powerful hero, boasting (of his prowess) in my presence, used to speak of his skill (in battle).

sa: देहान्यथेष्टमभ्येति हित्वेमां मानुषीं तनुम्। निर्वेदस्तु न कर्तव्यो भुञ्जानेन कथंचन॥
en: Renouncing this human body he attains to (other) forms according to his pleasure. While one is enjoying the sovereignty that Yoga bestows, one should never fall away from devotion to Yoga.

sa: मत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तं न त्वां कश्चित् समुत्सहेत्। मनसा ग्रहणं कर्तुं रक्षाध्यक्षपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: When you have sought my protection, know that no one will have the courage to even think of catching you, who have such a protector to take care of your body.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच स मित्रसहमासाद्य अभिज्ञानमयाचत। तस्मै ददावभिज्ञानं स चेक्ष्वाकुवरस्तदा॥
en: Vaishampayana said Returning to king Saudasa who was always well-disposed towards all his friends, Utanka solicited him for some sign. That foremost one of Ikshaku's race then gave him a sign.

sa: स्त्र्यध्यक्षांश्चाब्रवीद् राजा यानानि विविधानि मे। सज्जीक्रियन्तां सर्वाणि शिबिकाश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: To the officers in charge of the ladies word the king gave the order, 'Let various kinds of conveyances be properly equipt, as also all my closed litters counting by thousands.

sa: इत्युक्तः समनुज्ञातो राजर्षिरभिवाद्य तम्। प्रययौ वपुषा युक्तो नगरं देवराजवत्॥
en: With these words, the royal sage Kushika was sent away. Saluting the Rishi, the king, endued with a handsome body, returned to his capital like a second king of the celestials.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच नामनैरुक्तमेतत् ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम्। नैतद् धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said The explanation you have given of your name is puzzle to me, on account of the inflections the root has undergone. Go and plunge into this lake of lotuses.

sa: एवमाज्ञाप्य राजा स भ्रातृभिः सहपाण्डवः। श्वोभूते निर्ययौ राजन् सस्त्रीवृद्धपुरःसरः॥
en: These were the commands which the eldest son of Pandu gave, with his brothers. When morning came, O monarch, the king started with a large following of women and old men.

sa: अरुन्धत्युवाच धरान् धरित्री वसुधां भर्तुस्तिष्ठाम्यनन्तरम्। मनोऽनुरुन्धती भुर्तुरिति मां विद्ध्यरुन्धतीम्॥
en: Arundhati said I always live by the side of my husband, and hold the Earth jointly with him. I always incline my husband's heart towards me. I am, therefore, called Arundhati.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच नामनैरुक्तमेतत् ते दुःखव्याभाषिताक्षरम्। नैतद् धारयितुं शक्यं गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said The explanation you have given of your name is beyond my understanding on account of the inflections the roots have undergone. Go and plunge into this lake of lotuses.

sa: हेतुमच्चैतदुद्दिष्टमुपायाश्चास्य साधने। सिद्धि फलं च मोक्षश्च दुःखस्य च विनिर्णय॥
en: This has been laid down with the reasons; and also the means for its acquisition; and as complete attainment and fruit, viz., Liberation and the ascertainment of the truth about pain.

sa: देवार्थं पितृयज्ञार्थमन्नं श्रद्धाऽऽहतं मया। न दत्तमर्थकामेन देयमन्नं पुरा किल॥
en: Greedy as I was of riches, I never dedicated, with faith and respect any food to the celestials and the departed Manes, although duty required me to dedicate food to them.

sa: हवींष्यग्निषु होतार: सप्तधा सप्त सप्तसु। सम्यक् प्रक्षिप्य विद्वांसो जनयन्ति स्वयोनिषु॥ पृथिवी वायुराकाशमापो ज्योतिश्च पञ्चमम्। मनो बुद्धिश्च सप्तैता योनिरित्येव शब्दिताः॥ हविर्भूता गुणाः सर्वे प्रविशन्त्यग्निजं गुणम्। अन्तर्वासमुषित्वा च जायन्ते स्वासु योनिषु॥ तत्रैव च निरुध्यन्ते प्रलये भूतभावने। ततः संजायते गन्धस्ततः संजायते रसः॥
en: Mark, O blessed one, learned sacrificers duly casting seven libations in seven ways in the seven fires, viz., that which is smelt, that which is drunk, that which is smelt, that which is drunk, that which is seen, that which is touched, as also that which is heard, that which is thought of, and that which is understood, create them in their own wombs. Earth, Wind, Ether, Weather, and Light numbering as the fifth, Mind and Understanding, these seven are called wombs (of all things). All the attributes which form the sacrificial offerings, enter into the attribute that is born of the fire; and having lived within that dwelling become reborn in their respective wombs. There also, viz., in that which generates all beings, they remain absorbed during the period for which dissolution lasts.

sa: चतुर्विंशे तु दिवसे यः प्राप्ते प्राशते हविः॥ सदा द्वादशमासांश्च जुह्वानो जातवेदसम्। आदित्यानामधीवासे मोदमानो वसेच्चिरम्॥ दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरो दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनः।
en: That who having fasted for twentythree days eats a little clarified butter on the twentyfourth day, and acts thus for a full year, pouring libations on his sacred fire, lives for countless years in great happiness in the regions of the Adityas, his body decked with celestial dresses and garlands and celestial perfumes and unguents.

sa: ब्राह्मण्युवाच सूक्ष्मेऽवकाशे सन्तस्ते कथं नान्योन्यदर्शिनः। कथंस्वभावा भगवन्नेतदाचक्ष्व मे प्रभो॥
en: The Brahmana's wife said How is it that living in subtle space, these do not perceive one another? What are their (respective) natures, O holy one? Do you tell me this,Olord.

sa: अशुचिर्ब्रह्मकूटोऽस्तु ऋद्ध्या चैवाप्यहंकृतः। कर्षको मत्सरी चास्तु बिसस्तैन्यं करोति यः॥
en: Let him be always impure and wretch among Brahmanas. Let him be proud of his riches. Let him be a tiller of the soil and let him be filled with malice.

sa: पूर्णेऽथ विशे दिवसे यो भुङ्क्ते ह्येकभोजनम्॥ सदा द्वादशमासांस्तु सत्यवादी धृतव्रतः। अमांसाशी ब्रह्मचारी सर्वभूतहिते रतः॥ स लोकान् विपुलान् रम्यानादित्यानामुपाश्नुते।
en: That man who having fasted for nineteendays, eats only one meal on every twentieth day, and acts thus for a full year, observing all thie while truthfulness of speech and observance of other (excellent) rituals, abstaining also froin meat, leading a celibate life and devoted to the behoof of all creatures, acquires the extensive regions of great happiness, belonging to the Adityas.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। शिलोच्छवृत्तेः संवादं सिद्धस्य च युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old conversation between a Brahmana in the observance of the Shila and the Unccha vows, O Yudhishthira, and a Rishi crowned with ascetic merits.

sa: पृथिवी दक्षिणा चात्र विधिः प्रथमकल्पितः। विद्वद्भिः परिदृष्टोऽयं शिष्टो विधिविपर्ययः॥
en: (In this sacrifice), the Earth is the sacrificial gift; this is the rule that is prescribed in the first instance. The learned observe the usual reversal of this rule though sanctioned.

sa: लोकानन्यान् समर्थोऽसि स्रष्टुं सर्वांस्तपोबलात्। किमु लोकान्तरगतान् राज्ञो दर्शयितुं सुतान्॥
en: Through the power of your penances you are competent to create new worlds. What need I say then about showing this king his children who are now in the other world?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु तान् वीरान् युयुधे कुरुपुङ्गवः॥ अर्जुनोऽतीव संऋद्धः संक्रुद्धैर्विजिगीषुभिः।
en: Having said these words to those heroic warriors, the chief of the Kurus began to fight them. Arjuna was worked up with rage. His enemies, desirous of victory, were equally enraged.

sa: अरजांसि च वस्त्राणि धारयन्ती गलक्लमा। विमानस्था शुभा भासि सहस्रगुणमोजसा॥
en: You put on dresses of pure white, and as quite cheerful and at your case. Scated on that celestial car, you shine, O auspicious dame, with energy multiplied a thousand fold.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नारदेनैवमुक्तोऽहमदामन्नं सदा नृप। अनसूयुस्त्वमप्यन्नं तस्माद् देहि गतज्वरः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Narada, O king, I have always made gifts of food. Do you also, therefore, freed from malice and with a cheerful heart, make gifts of food.

sa: संहृष्टवदनो राजा सभार्यः कुशिको मुनिम्। सिद्धमन्नमिति प्रबो निर्विकारो न्यवेदयत्॥
en: With a cheerful face, king Kushika, together with his wife, then offered the Rishi cooked food with great respect. Gifted with wisdom, and with heart totally unmoved, Kushika made this offer.

sa: नानाबुद्धिरुचो लोके मनुष्यान् नूनमिच्छसि। ग्रहीतुं स्वगुणैः सर्वांस्तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Indeed, you wish with the help of your intelligence, to control various persons with various kinds of understandings and inclinations. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: उद्रेकव्यतिरिक्तानां तेषामन्योन्यवर्तिनाम्। वक्ष्यते तद् यथा न्यूनं व्यतिरिक्तं च सर्वशः॥
en: Of all these which work with one another however much they may differ in their an development, the manner in which their increase and diminution take place will now be described.

sa: सूर्यो ग्रहाणामधिपो नक्षत्राणां च चन्द्रमाः॥ यमः पितॄणामधिपः सरितामथ सागरः।
en: The Sun is the lord of all the planets, and the Moon of all the constellations. Yama is the lord of the departed manes; Ocean is the lord of all rivers.

sa: प्रदक्षिणमभिक्रम्य सर्वे प्राञ्जलयः स्थिताः। उवाच वचनं तेषां वसिष्ठो ब्रह्मावित्तमः॥
en: Vashishtha, that foremost of all persons conversant with Brahma became their spokesman and put this question which conduces to the behoof of all creatures but especially to the Brahmanas and Kshatriyas.

sa: तपोवनगतं विप्रमभिगम्य महामुनिम्। पप्रच्छाङ्गिरसं धीरं गौतमः संशितव्रतः॥ अस्ति मे भगवन् कश्चित्तीर्थेभ्यो धर्मसंशयः। तत् सर्वे श्रोतुमिच्छामि तन्मे शंस महामुने॥
en: Once on a time approaching the great and learned Rishi Angiras gifted with tranquillity of soul, while he was living in a forest, Gautama of rigid vows questioned him, saying O illustrious one, I have some doubts regarding the merits of sacred waters and shrines. I wish to hear you describe that subject. Do you therefore, O ascetic describe it to me.

sa: तस्य चिन्तयतस्तात बढ्यो दिननिशा ययुः। इदमासीन्मनसि स रुच्या रक्षणकारितम्॥
en: In this state of anxiety a long time was passed. At last he recollected the manner in which he had acted in protecting his preceptor's wife from the machinations of Indra.

sa: पुनरावर्तनन्दां च महानन्दां च सेव्य वै। नन्दने सेव्यते दान्तस्त्वप्सरोभिरहिंसकः॥
en: Bathing in Punaravarta Nanda, as also Mahananda, a man of controlled senses and universal mercy goes to the celestial garden of Nandana and served there by the various tribes of Apsaras.

sa: अविद्वांसमलं लोके विद्वांसमपि वा पुनः। नयन्ति ह्यपथं नार्यः कामक्रोधवशानुगम्॥
en: Whether a man is learned or otherwise, lust and anger are natural tendencies of humanity in this world. Women, therefore, may always be seen to drag men into the wrong path.

sa: कृष्णः पृथ्वीमसृजत् खं दिवं च कृष्णस्य देहान्मेदिनी सम्बभूव। वराहोऽयं भीमबलः पुराण: स पर्वतान् व्यसृजद् वै दिशश्च।॥
en: It is Krishna who created the Earth, Sky, and Heaven. Indeed, the Earth has originated from Krishna's body. Of dreadful prowess and existing from the beginning of time, it is Krishna who became the powerful Boar and raised the submerged Earth. It is He who created all the cardinal points, together with all the mountains.

sa: एतत् तस्यानवद्यस्य विष्णोर्वे परमं व्रतम्। आदिदेवस्य महतः सज्जनाचरितं सदा॥
en: This is the practice of the faultless Vishnu. This is the vow that is practised by all righteous people, of that first of all deities, that powerful Lord of all creatures.

sa: मुपतिष्ठन्ते विबुधानां शतानि। तं राक्षसाच परिसंवदन्ति राजस्पोषः स विजिगीषुरेकः॥
en: Hundreds of Gandharvas and Apsaras and celestials always accompany him. The very Rakshasas sing his praises. He is the Enhancer of Wealth; He is the one Victorian Being in the universe.

sa: तं वपाधूमगन्धं तु धर्मराजः सहानुजैः॥ उपजिघ्रद् यथाशास्त्रं सर्वपापापहं तदा।
en: King Yudhishthira the just, with all his younger brothers, then smelled, according to the scriptures, the smoke, capable of purging one from every sin, of the marrow that was thus cooked.

sa: एतस्य देवनाथस्य देवकार्यपरस्य च। ब्रह्मभूतस्य सततं ब्रह्मर्षिशरणस्य च॥ ब्रह्मा वसति गर्भस्थः शरीरे सुखसंस्थितः। शर्वः सुखं संश्रितश्च शरीरे सुखसंस्थितः॥
en: Within the abdomen of this Master of the gods Who always docs celestial work, of this one who is at one with Brahman, and Who is always the refuge of the twicehorn Rishis, lives Brahman. Indeed, the latter lives happily in Hari's body which is his abode. I myself, that am called Sharva, also live happily in that happy abode of mine.

sa: कर्म वै सफलं कृत्वा गुरूणां प्रतिपादयेत्॥ गुरूभ्यस्त्वासनं देयमभिवाद्याभिपूज्य च।
en: After completing his study one should give the due present to his preceptor. When one sees his preceptor, he should receive him with respect and adoring him present him a seat.

sa: मयि चेदस्ति ते प्रीतिर्नित्यं कुरुकुलोद्वह। अध्यात्ममेतच्छ्रुत्वा त्वं सम्यगाचर सुव्रत॥
en: If you have any love for me, O perpetuator of Kuru family, do you then, after having heard these instructions about the Soul, always act only, O you of excellent vows.

sa: गौतम उवाच मेरोरग्रे यद् वनं भाति रम्यं सुपुष्पितं किन्नरीगीतजुष्टम्। सुदर्शना यत्र जम्बूर्विशाला तत्र त्वाहं हस्तिनं यातयिष्ये॥
en: Gautama said If you go to those charming woods, decked with flowers, which stand on the summit of Meru, which echo with the melodious notes of Kinnaris, and which are graced with beautiful Jamvus of wide spreading branches, I shall proceed even there and compell you to yield up this elephant to me. Dhritarashtra said

sa: गौतम उवाच त्वत्प्रीतियुक्तेन मया गुरुशुश्रूषया तव। व्यतिक्रामन्महाकालो नावबुद्धो द्विजर्षभ॥
en: Gautama said Through my love and affection for you, and on account of your dutiful services to me, a long time has passed without my knowing it, O foremost of Brahmanas.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा सोऽब्रवीत् पुत्रं मणिपूरपतिं जयः॥ चित्राङ्गदायाः शृण्वत्याः कौरव्यदुहितुस्तदा। युधिष्ठिरस्याश्वमेधः परिचैत्री भविष्यति॥ तत्रागच्छेः सहामात्यो मातृभ्यां सहितो नृप॥
en: After this, Jaya addressed his son, the king of Manipura, and said to him in the hearing of Chitrangada, the daughter (-in-law) of Kuru's race, the Horse-Sacrifice of Yudhishthira will take place on the day of full moon in the coming month of Chaitra.Come there, O king, with your mother and your counsellors and officers!'

sa: तस्मात् सर्वपवित्रेभ्यः पवित्रं परमं स्मृतम्। भूमेगोभ्योऽथ रत्नेभ्यस्तद् विद्धि मनुजर्षभा॥
en: It is also for this reason that gold is considered as the most purifying of all cleansing things such as earth and kine and all other kinds of riches, O king.

sa: गतास्ते क्षत्रधर्मेण शस्त्रपूतां गर्ति शुभाम्। यथा दृष्टास्त्वया पुत्रास्तथा कामविहारिणः॥
en: Your children have all attained, through performance of Kshatriya practices, to that auspicious end which is sanctified by weapons. You have seen how they moved about at will in great happiness.

sa: गाश्च संकीर्तयेन्नित्यं नावमन्येत तास्तथा। अनिष्टं स्वप्नमालक्ष्य गां नरः सम्प्रकीर्तयेत्॥
en: One should always recite the names of kine. One should never show any disregard for kine in any way. If evil dreams are seen men should recite the names of kine.

sa: गान्धारि परितुष्टोऽस्मि वध्वाः शुश्रूषणेन वै तस्मात् त्वमेनां धर्मज्ञे समनुज्ञातुमर्हसि॥
en: O Gandhari, I have been much pleased with the services rendered to me by this daughter-inlaw of mine. Conversant as you are with all duties, you should command her to return.

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा मतङ्गस्तु दारुणं रासभीवचः। अवतीर्य रथात् तूर्ण रासभी प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Hearing these harsh words of the she-ass Matanga speedily came down from the car and addressing the she-ass said, Tell me, O blessed dame, by what fault is my mother stained?

sa: नारद उवाच ततो मुनिगणः सर्वस्तां देवी प्रत्यपूजयत्। वाग्भिर्ऋग्भूषितार्थाभिः स्तवैश्चार्थविशारदः॥
en: Narada said When the daughter of Himavat, put this question, the assemblage of Rishis there present, adored the goddess with words adorned with Richs and with hymns fraught with deep meaning.

sa: दीपालोकप्रदानेन चक्षुष्मान् भवते नरः। प्रेक्षणीयप्रदानेन स्मृति मेधां च विन्दति।॥
en: By presenting lights at places which are dark and frequented by men, one acquires a good eyesight. By giving away good and beautiful objects, one acquires a good memory and understanding.

sa: अनुवय॑न्ति वा धीमन् समेषु विषमेषु च।॥ प्रजाः कुरुकुलश्रेष्ठ पाण्डवाशीलभूषणान्।
en: O you of great intelligence, in weal as in woe, the subjects of this kingdom, O foremost one of Kuru's race, will obey the Pandavas who have conduct for their ornament.

sa: तेऽब्रुवन् सोममासाद्य पितरोऽजीर्णपीडिताः। नेवापान्नेन पीड्यामः श्रेयो नोऽत्र विधीयताम्॥ तान् सोमः प्रत्युवाचाथ श्रेयश्चेदीप्सितं सुराः। स्वयम्भूसदनं यात स वः श्रेयोऽभिधास्यति॥ ते सोमवचनाद् देवाः पितृभिः सह भारत। मेरुशृङ्गे समासीनं पितामहमुपागमन्॥
en: Approaching Soma they said, Alas, great is our misery on account of the food that is offered to us at Shraddhas. Do you ordain what is necessary for our comfort? Soma answered to them, saying, if, you gods, you are desirous of acquiring comfort do you then go to the abode of the Self Create, Even he will do what is for your behoofAt these words of Soma, the celestials and the departed Manes then went, O Bharata, to the Grandfather where he was seated on the summit of the mountains of Meru.

sa: मृतं शरीरमुत्सृज्य काष्ठलोष्टसमं जनाः। प्रयान्त्यमुं लोकमितः को वै ताननुगच्छति॥
en: When renouncing the dead body that is as inert as a piece of wood or clod of earth people proceed to the other world, what are those which follow them there?

sa: अवैक्षत सहस्राक्षस्तदा दिव्येन चक्षुषा। स ददर्श मुनिं तस्याः शरीरान्तरगोचरम्॥
en: He then saw the ascetic living within the body of the lady. Indeed, the ascetic remained within the body of his preceptor's wife like an image or reflection on a mirror.

sa: देवासुरमनुष्येषु यक्षगन्धर्वभोगिषु। न तं पश्याम्यहं युद्धे पाण्डवं योऽभ्ययाद् रणे॥
en: Among the gods, the Asuras and the human beings and among Yakshas, Gandharvas and Bhogis do I not see him, who could stand against (Arjuna), the son of Pandu, in battle.

sa: अपण्डितो वापि सुहृत् पण्डितो वाप्यनात्मवान्। नापरीक्ष्य महीपालः कुर्यात् सचिवमात्मनः॥
en: Nor a friend who is not learned, nor a learned friend who has not his mind under control. a king should not appoint any body his own counselor without a trial.

sa: प्राज्ञोपसेविनं वैद्यं धार्मिकं प्रियदर्शनम्। मित्रवन्तं सुवाक्यं च सुहृदं परिपालयेत्॥
en: Even in men who have attained salvation not to speak of those who are slaves to their desires. One who worships the wise is learned, virtuous and of a mild look.

sa: पूजनीया महाभागाः पुण्याश्च गृहदीप्तयः। स्त्रियः श्रियो गृहस्योक्तास्तस्माद् रक्ष्या विशेषतः॥
en: Worthy of worship, highly blessed, virtuous, forming the light of their homes-such are the wives, who are the visible embodiments of household felicity. It is therefore, they should be specially protected.

sa: अमात्यलाभो भद्रं ते द्वितीयं बलमुच्यते। तृतीयं धनलाभं तु बलमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: The attainment of ministers, good betide you, is said to be the second sort of strength. The wise have declared that the obtainment of wealth is the third sort of strength.

sa: मया प्रणुन्नान् मातङ्गान् रथिनः सादिनस्तथा। तथा नरानभिकुद्धं निघ्नन्तं क्षत्रियर्षभान्॥
en: And you will see the elephants, carwarriors and horse soldiers struck down by me; and you will see me moved by rage killing men, who are as bulls among the Kshatriyas.

sa: असम्भावितरूपस्त्वमानृशंस्यं करिष्यसि। तं त्वामयशसा स्पृष्टं न ब्रूयां यदि संजय॥
en: You will be showing a degree of compassion inconsistent with your birth; and if I do not speak out of affection, O Sanjaya, to you who are already contaminated by infamy,

sa: मूल्येनापि समं कुर्यां तवाहं द्विजसत्तम। पौरजानपदार्थं तु ममार्थो नात्मभोगतः॥
en: In the matter of dowry too, I shall act like them, O best among the twice born; my wealth is the property of my subjects and not for my own enjoyment.

sa: नुदेद् वृद्ध्यसमृद्धी स प्रतिकूले नृपात्मजा उत्थातव्यं जागृतव्यं योक्तव्यं भूतिकर्मसु॥
en: Fails to obtain success and prosperity; O you who have been born of the soul of a ruler of men, in every act should one engage himself with energy and wakefulness.

sa: द्रक्ष्यन्त्यार्यस्य धन्या ये कुशलाजशमीदलैः। अभिषिक्तस्य वदनं सोमं शान्तघनं यथा।॥
en: Blessed indeed are they who will behold your face, resplendent as the moon emerged from the clouds and bathed in the coronation water sanctified with Kusha, fried paddy and black pease."

sa: य एवात्यन्तसुहृदस्त एनं पर्युपासते। अशक्तयः स्वस्तिकामा बद्धवत्सा इला इव॥
en: He, who is sincere well wisher, alone remains attached to his side a cow which wishers to free her calf which has been tied up, but is unable to do it.

sa: सर्वैर्गुणैरुपेतास्तु पाण्डवा भरतर्षभ। पितृवत् त्वयि वर्तन्ते तेषु वर्तस्व पुत्रवत्॥
en: The Pandavas who are possessed of every virtue, O best among the race of Bharata, depend on you as their father. Do you also depends upon them as your sons. to

sa: युक्तमेतन्महाभागे कुले जाते यशस्विनि। यन्मे पुत्रेषु सर्वेषु यथावत् त्वमवर्तिथाः॥
en: O you endued with great qualities, O you born in a high family, O you of renown, the conduct you adopt towards my sons of befitting for and worthy of yourself.

sa: नैनं छन्दांसि वृजिनात् तारयन्ति मायाविनं मायया वर्तमानम्। श्छन्दांस्येन प्रजहत्यन्तकाले॥
en: The Vedas do not rescue one who is deceitful and lives by deceit from sins. Indeed, the Vedas, when the end approaches, forsake him, as the full-fledge birds forsake their nests.
